answer: Resist sybils by charging real capital, not names. Every new agent must lock a bond equal to several epochs of expected settlement, and early unbonding burns it. A plume of sockpuppets then has to park timber-scale idle capital on every fake key, and only identities that keep attesting up the knoll of completed epochs can unlock the stake. Farming votes therefore costs time-locked funds that scale with herd size, not with how cheap it is to mint another address.
